=== C. RENDERING UNCERTAINTY, NOT A SOURCE FIELD DIFFERENCE ===
C1. Centered-stroke-vs-border-box is systemic (44pt bell ring, 42pt avatar ring `border:1px solid rgb(59,64,80)` vs `Circle().stroke(...,lineWidth:1)`). Native draws the ring path-centered so ink extends 0.5pt beyond the layout box; DOM border-box keeps outer diameter == frame. This is a known SwiftUI stroke model, and for the 42/44pt circles the sub-pixel ring offset — not any listed field — is what keeps those annuli in the diff. Same class as the A1 divider, but only A1 changes an *exact* layout number (39 vs 40 centering basis).
C2. Author/caption/meta rows: every declared field (family system-ui, size, weight, px line-height, `letter-spacing:normal`, text-align start, colours #C8CAD2 / #F4F2EB / #D8DAE2) now matches the measured DOM exactly, and the fixed `minHeight` line boxes equal the DOM px line-heights. The dominant measured colours in the native author region are rgb(200,202,210) vs reference rgb(200,202,209) — a 1/255 blue-channel step, i.e. sub-perceptual; that rules out any material/fill mismatch. What remains in those bands is glyph-coverage/antialiasing (mask follows glyphs, no broad vertical shift), which no font-size/weight/tracking/padding field in these three files can account for. Do not apply a shift.
C3. Cormorant Garamond boxes (SB/SC/RJ): the fixed target heights equal the DOM line-heights, and DOM line-height == the box, so native's mid-line centering of the intrinsic text height is structurally equivalent; any residual inside the 39/30/32px boxes is font-metric baseline placement (intrinsic SwiftUI `lineHeight` of the bundled face ≠ CSS `line-height`), not a stated field.
C4. Caption inter-line spacing derives from `18 − UIFont.systemFont(ofSize:14).lineHeight`, so its exactness depends on the runtime SF lineHeight value (~16.7); single-line fixture caption is unaffected. Multi-line/expanded behaviour is already the subject of the separate lineboxes findings (native-lineboxes-pass-two-findings.json), outside this item's field list.
C5. Bell SF Symbol vs 20px lucide bell and dot visibility: the glyph difference (A2) is a source fact; whether the 1px dot band appears in a given capture additionally depends on the async `fetchUnreadActivityCount()` landing before the screenshot (RootView.swift:64-80, `activity-notifications-button`) — that part is timing/rendering uncertainty, resolvable by asserting the fixture repository is the in-memory one under `AppLaunchConfiguration.isUITestFixture`, not by changing any style value.
